newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Group optimistic for 1997 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Group optimistic for 1997 earnings.

text.p: The Morgan Group said Monday that it is optimistic that revenues and profits will show a sharp rebound in 1997. The company reported a net loss of $2.1 million in 1996.

Morgan said not only will the company benefit from the elimination of the substantial losses registered in its Truckaway operations, but improved claims and insurance expenses are expected, as is a paring of corporate overhead.

The company also emphasized that it will benefit in 1997 from the December 30 purchase of Transit Homes of America. This acquisition, which consolidates Morgan's long-standing leadership position in delivery services to the manufactured housing industry, should add approximately $25 million in top line revenues and is expected to add to full year profits as well, said the company.
